barRaise.topFinding: The advisory gate has failed 12 consecutive runs since 2026-07-25 on the same stale transitive axios reached through plaid@42.2.0, and the fix is lighter than three prior runs assumed: plaid's own ^1.7.4 range already permits the patched 1.19.0, so a lockfile refresh clears all ten axios advisories with no permanent override entry. finance-product-dedupe-02 stopped being hypothetical: three genuine charges the bank distinguishes by Reference Number were silently eaten by the UNIQUE(account_id, posted_date, amount, raw_description) key and are missing from the live ledger, and both snapshot directories hold zero files, so this install has had no restore point for 32 days while carrying 649 transactions. The review loop also dropped a whole day: no artifact exists for 2026-07-29 because a host-wide memory-exhaustion blackout swallowed the slot, yet the registry stamped lastRunAt for a run that left no session record and write-dashboard-status.ps1:205 hardcodes stale = false, so the dashboard read calm through all of it. The one real improvement is commit 8533182, which landed the stranded SECURITY_POLICY.md edit and the D-009 to D-005 citation fix, closing both findings the nightly audit raised.
